notes.title: Coming soon | Rescue HQ - The Tycoon
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/809720/Rescue_HQ__The_Tycoon/

A few days left - our first Tycoon "Rescue HQ" will be released on 28.05.2019!

In Rescue HQ you build, organise, and manage a station for the three emergency departments police, fire brigade, and ambulance. With a limited initial budget, you further develop the HQ, expand your crew with new employees and provide them with all the equipment and vehicles they need.

In addition, Rescue HQ can be extensively modded. Create or download your own assets, maps, and missions via the Steam Workshop and connect with the community!

Add "Rescue HQ - The Tycoon" now to your wishlist!

notes.title: Patch Note for Update on 8th of September 2016
notes.content:
A new update for Autobahn Police Simulator is online. We fixed some bugs in this update.

* World loading bug is fixed now
* Sensitivity settings in the option menu are working again
* We improve vehicle controls.

A lot of people didn't like the last update of the vehicle controls, so we tried to implement their feedback. We will see if there are more feedback for the controls and try to improve it.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Release (24th September 2015)
notes.content:
# Re-engineered the controls
# Added more actions (steering/strafing split up into two distinct actions, added engine and handbrake toggles) which can be mapped onto input devices
# Added different input handling for steering wheels and gamepads (see note below)
# Added sensitivity settings for camera and steering controls
# Replaced follow camera logic
# Tweaked the police cars physics
# Improved english localization
# Added SMAA-Antialiasing. This is faster than SSAA, so antialiasing can be used on lower hardware
# Improved the routine for deciding which accidents appear next, giving more variety
# Added default control mapping for the XBox 360 gamepad
# Fixed Accidents on gas station which sometimes clipped into geometry
# Fixed initial profile creation
# Fixed "Please Follow" bug where the AI suddenly drives away during vehicle inspection
# Added a hint when the profile depth is too low when checking wheels
# Fixes of other, smaller bugs

This update resets your control-settings, so please check if the mappings on your gamepad/steering wheel are still consistent. If you use a steering wheel, change the "Input mode" setting in the "Controls" section of the options menu to "Steering wheel". Otherwise the vehicles will not react properly to the steering wheel rotation! If you use a gamepad with thumbsticks or digitial input like keyboard, you should not change this setting or the vehicles might become uncontrollable.
